text_en: To the leader: Do Not Destroy. Of David. A Miktam.
text_cn: 达味金诗，交与乐官。调寄“莫要毁坏”。

text_en: Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods? Do you judge people fairly?
text_cn: 判官们！你们是否真正出言公平？ 世人们！你们是否照理审断案情？

text_en: No, in your hearts you devise wrongs; your hands deal out violence on earth.
text_cn: 可惜你们一心只想为非作恶， 在地上你们的双手只行宰割。

text_en: The wicked go astray from the womb; they err from their birth, speaking lies.
text_cn: 作恶者一离母胎，即背离正路； 说谎者一出母腹，即走入歧途。

text_en: They have venom like the venom of a serpent, like the deaf adder that stops its ear,
text_cn: 他们满怀的毒素有如蛇毒； 他们又像塞住耳朵的聋蝮，

text_en: so that it does not hear the voice of charmers or of the cunning enchanter.
text_cn: 不听巫士的音语， 不随灵妙的妖术。

text_en: O God, break the teeth in their mouths; tear out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord !
text_cn: 天主，求你把他们口中的牙齿捣烂， 上主，求你把少壮狮子的牙床打断。

text_en: Let them vanish like water that runs away; like grass let them be trodden down and wither.
text_cn: 愿他们有如奔湍的急水流去， 愿他们有如被踏的青草枯萎；

text_en: Let them be like the snail that dissolves into slime; like the untimely birth that never sees the sun.
text_cn: 愿他们有如蜗牛爬过溶化消失， 又如流产的胎儿不得亲见天日！

text_en: Sooner than your pots can feel the heat of thorns, whether green or ablaze, may he sweep them away!
text_cn: 他们的锅在未觉到荆火以前， 愿狂怒的烈风将他们全吹散！

text_en: The righteous will rejoice when they see vengeance done; they will bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.
text_cn: 义人看见大仇已报时，必然喜乐， 他要在恶人的血中洗自己的脚。

text_en: People will say, “Surely there is a reward for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges on earth. ”
text_cn: 如此，众人都说：“义人果然获得了好的报酬， 世上确有执行审判的天主！”
